notes: New: Perfect shapes. Draw a circle, a triangle, a square, any polygon or an arrow with the pen or the mouse and hold still at its end: it becomes a Geometry figure on the grid, outlined, to move, resize and edit. A line or curve held over a graph becomes the graph of its function; held lines can make a coordinate system, a table or a number line. On by default, off in Settings. Also: a graph's functions can be changed with their pencil, and its eye hides a curve again.
